expectations.text: URL 기반 버전 관리를 설정한다 (URLPathVersioning 또는 URL prefix api/v1/, api/v2/)
expectations.evidence: urls.py uses path("api/v1/", include(router_v1.urls)) and path("api/v2/", include(router_v2.urls)) with separate routers per version.

serializers_v1.py defines ProductListSerializer and ProductDetailSerializer for v1. serializers_v2.py defines separate ProductListSerializer and ProductDetailSerializer for v2 with additional fields (avg_rating, seller, discounted_price).

expectations.text: ViewSet에서 get_serializer_class()로 버전에 따라 Serializer를 분기한다
expectations.evidence: views_v1.py and views_v2.py each define a ProductViewSet with get_serializer_class() that returns version-specific serializers (list vs detail). Version routing is achieved by URL prefix dispatching to separate ViewSets, each importing from its own serializer module.

expectations.text: v2 목록 조회에 select_related('seller') + annotate(avg_rating=Avg(...))로 N+1을 방지한다
expectations.evidence: views_v2.py get_queryset() chains select_related("category", "seller").with_avg_rating(). The with_avg_rating() method in models.py ProductQuerySet is defined as annotate(avg_rating=Avg("reviews__rating")).
